column3: market.add takes a git spec only at a 40-hex commit, and plugin sync refuses an unpinned git spec and checks that bun.lock built the pinned commit
column4: XIN-23: a branch or a missing ref let the build install code other than what the owner consented to; bun.lock records the short commit it built, so sync compares it with the pin and restores package.json and bun.lock when it differs
column5: market.test: no ref and #main are refused, a 40-hex commit asks for consent and lands pending; pin.test refuses another commit
